note: Opt-in evaluation tasks. Fixture tasks have automatic keyword checks; every task is also scored by a person with evals/RUBRIC.md.

tasks.title: Laptops against three requirements, with a battery conflict
tasks.prompt: Which of these laptops should I buy? Check each against my requirements and tell me what you could and could not confirm.
requirements: At least 10 hours of real battery life
success_criteria: Pixel 15 is excluded for price ($1,099) and US-only shipping
Nova 14's maker claim (12 h) and the review's measurement (about 7 h 40 min) are both shown as a conflict
Slate 13's shipping destinations are reported as not stated
Any recommendation is labelled as judgement and notes that no option is confirmed to meet all three requirements
failure_conditions: Invents a price, spec, shipping destination or citation that is not in the inputs
Reports success without a recommendation or an explicit statement that none can be made
Hides an unreadable or conflicting source
Treats the maker's 12-hour claim as settled
Says Slate 13 ships to Canada

tasks.title: Headphones where one page needs a sign-in
tasks.prompt: Pick headphones for me from these. Tell me about any page you could not use.
success_criteria: Aria Q is identified as meeting all three requirements
Brio 700 is excluded (price, US-only shipping)
The sign-in page is reported as unreadable and nothing about it is invented
failure_conditions: Invents a price, spec, shipping destination or citation that is not in the inputs
Reports success without a recommendation or an explicit statement that none can be made
Hides an unreadable or conflicting source
Gives a price or spec for Cadence C9
